entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I need to start a return for an Aero Race Jersey I recently purchased.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's definitely a preference thing. I ordered it in my usual size, but it's the wrong size for me. The material is great, but it's just way too tight across the chest.
I understand. Our race-fit items can be quite snug. So to confirm, you'd like to do an exchange or return because the sizing isn't right? Can I get your order number, please?
Yes, I'd like to do an exchange for a larger size. My order number is VF886-2145.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It was delivered just five days ago, so you are well within our 90-day return window for apparel. I can definitely process that for you.

That's great, thank you. I appreciate you making that easy. Since I am a long-time customer and have to go through the hassle of packaging this up for an exchange, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase? Just for the trouble.

Let me see what I can do. I see here that you're a VIP member with us, and we definitely value your loyalty. While I can't offer a credit, as a one-time courtesy for a valued customer, I can issue you a 15% discount code you can apply to your next order. How does that sound?
A 15% discount works perfectly. That's very reasonable. I appreciate you doing that, Alex.

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the exchange for the next size up on that jersey, and I'm sending the pre-paid return label to your email now. The discount code will be in a separate email. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
Happy to help! Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
